title: Small-model surjection onto etale generator sections
statement: For every scheme X in universe u and every U in the opposite of its small etale site, there is a type α : Type u and a surjection α → ((etaleSmallGenerator X).obj.obj U).

source.place: Sheafified free abelian representables and the affine-open covering argument

proof.text: The private helper small_colimit proves that a u-small diagram of pointwise u-small abelian groups has a u-small colimit: its direct sum is small by DFinsupp.small, its quotient is small, and AddCommGrpCat.isColimit_iff_bijective_desc gives a surjection from that quotient to the chosen colimit. No additional unproved statement is used.

On a small category, covers and their arrow types lie in Type u. In small_plus, each Meq type is a subtype of a small dependent product. GrothendieckTopology.Plus.exists_rep shows that the sigma type of covers and matching families surjects onto plus sections. Apply small_plus twice and plusPlusIsoSheafify to prove small_sheafify for any choice of the sheafification left adjoint. These helpers are proved in Lean.

The helper small_sheaf_colimit computes the presheaf colimit pointwise using colimitObjIsoColimitCompEvaluation, applies small_colimit, then sheafifies using small_sheafify. Sheaf.isColimitSheafifyCocone identifies this result with the chosen sheaf colimit. Apply it to the small coproduct in the concrete generator [def-sc-etale-small-generator]; each free-Yoneda presheaf has small sections by small_colimit, and its sheafification by small_sheafify.

The helper small_dense_extension sends a section to all its restrictions along maps from objects of the small dense site. The target dependent product is u-small, and Functor.IsCoverDense.ext proves injectivity. The small-model comparison unit identifies the restricted values of the affine transported generator with the already bounded small-model sections.

For an essentially u-small dense source, small_dense_extension_essentiallySmall indexes this same restriction map only by SmallModel source. To prove injectivity for an arbitrary source object, use its small-model unit isomorphism: restrict along its inverse and then back along its forward map; functoriality and the inverse identity recover the original restriction. Cover-density then detects the section. Apply this to AffineEtale.Spec and use the second comparison unit to bound sections on the full etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site].

For the resulting small section type, take alpha to be its Shrink and f to be the inverse of equivShrink. The inverse equivalence is surjective. The constructions of matching families and dependent products include empty covers and empty objects without a separate case.
